newsitem.title: CANADA: Canrock buys Talisman Canada plant stake.
newsitem.headline: Canrock buys Talisman Canada plant stake.

text.p: Canrock Pipeline Co Ltd, a natural gas processing firm indirectly owned by Brussels-based Electrafina SA, said on Monday it bought Talisman Energy Inc's stake in a Canadian gas plant for an undisclosed sum.

Canrock said purchase of the interest in the Gordondale Gas Plant in northeast British Columbia and 100 percent of the Gordondale pipeline system would add 26 million cubic feet per day of processing capacity, 46 km of gathering lines and 1,600 horsepower of compression to its assets in the region.
Canrock's total capacity in the area would increase to 84 million cubic feet a day from 58 million, making it one of the larger "custom" processors in the Northern Peace River Arch region, it said.

Under the deal, Canrock would provide operating and processing service to Talisman in exchange for the right to process all current and economically viable future gas production in the immediate area, Canrock said.
Canrock is a subsidiary of Texas-based Rockland Pipeline Co, which is owned by Electrafina.
